name: Woodcraft of St. Louis - Maryland Heights
old_description: Trusted by woodworkers since 1928, Woodcraft has built a reputation for providing quality tools, expert guidance, and exceptional customer service. Whether you're purchasing your first machine or upgrading a lifelong workshop, you can shop with confidence knowing you're choosing equipment backed by nearly a century of woodworking experience. Browse our collection to find reliable machines that help you create with precision for years to come.
about:
Woodcraft of St. Louis – Maryland Heights operates at 2077 Congressional Drive in St. Louis, Missouri. The location is part of the Woodcraft chain, a national retailer of woodworking tools and supplies that traces its origins to 1928. The store is independently operated as a franchise; no individual founders are named in the available information.

The business sells power tools, hand tools, lumber, and accessories from brands such as JET, Powermatic, Festool, Laguna, Rikon, WoodRiver, Pfeil, Flexcut, and Veritas. It also runs a program of woodworking classes and free monthly demonstrations covering topics like finishing techniques, cutting board construction, and router lift operation. The facility serves as a retail showroom and classroom; no manufacturing or fabrication is performed on site.

Customers include hobbyist woodworkers, professional craftspeople, and beginners seeking instruction. Classes such as "Finishing 301: Top Coats," "Woodworking Fundamentals: Cutting Board," and "Date Night: Drunken Cutting Board" illustrate the range of skill levels addressed. Demo events feature specific product lines like JessEm router lifts and marking tools.

Woodcraft positions the store as a destination where woodworkers can find quality equipment, expert advice, and hands-on learning in one place. The emphasis on guided product selection and skill-building workshops distinguishes it from pure online or big-box retailers.
